name: Electro

abilityDetails.Static Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Aldığı hasarın bir kısmını enerji hasarı olarak geri verir — yüksek enerji direnci veya yetenek azaltıcı şampiyon kullan.
signatureAbility:
Electrostatic
Building Power levels in both players charge the atmosphere, increasing Critical Rating by up to [327.08 - 3,370.17] based on the stored Power in both Electro and his opponent.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Electro takes no damage from Shock effects and each Shock grants Electro +[846.8] Attack and +15% Static Shock damage.
Incoming Shock effects gain +75% Ability Accuracy and Duration.

abilitySections.title: When Attacked
content: Opponents that make contact with you receive a Static Shock for 38% of the damage they inflicted as Energy Damage. This damage is Science based, dealing increased damage to Mystic Champions and reduced damage to Skill Champions.
